title: System Administrator
description:
**About CynLr** 




  





 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to
 **instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Demo Video** 




 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to
 **assemble a Smartphone** 
 or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 As a
 *System Administrator at CynLr* 
 , you will design, build, and evolve IT infrastructure, processes, and practices that support research, product development, and operations, while ensuring efficient, secure, and sustainable usage. Process for the sake of process will not be entertained;
 *utility and convenience take precedence, and every system must justify its existence by improving real outcomes.* 





  





 CynLr's ambition demands not only breakthrough algorithms and hardware, but also a
 *robust, adaptive, and human\-centric IT infrastructure* 
 that allows teams to operate with minimal friction and maximum focus. As CynLr scales across disciplines, tools, and geographies,
 *IT infrastructure becomes the information backbone of the organization.* 
 The goal of this role is not merely uptime or compliance, but to
 *augment human productivity* 
 , eliminate hidden delays and context\-switching costs, and ensure that technology remains an enabler rather than a constraint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***A. Operate***




  




* Run and maintain IT infrastructure supporting research, engineering, and operations at scale.
* Administer the Office 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, identity and access).
* Operate and secure endpoint devices across Windows, Android, BYOD, and corporate assets.
* Manage network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs.
* Perform hands\-on monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution across hardware, OS, network, and applications.



  





***B. Build***




  




* Design and deploy Azure AD, Intune, and SharePoint policies for secure and organized access.
* Set up and maintain hardware infrastructure—laptops, workstations, servers, networking, and conferencing systems.
* Configure and support Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware / Hyper\-V).
* Establish remote workflows and inter\-office connectivity to enable distributed teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hardware, software, and service vendors.



  





***C. Improve***



* Automate workflows and remediation using PowerShell scripting to reduce manual effort.
* Evaluate and select hardware and software based on supportability, ecosystem maturity, scalability, and lifecycle cost.
* Proactively monitor systems, analyse failures, and implement preventive and reliability improvements.
* Continuously refine IT processes and practices to remove friction and improve user productivity.



  





**Team Structure:** 



* The Operations team at CynLr functions as a
 *cross\-functional enablement layer* 
 that supports Engineering, Product, and Business teams in executing reliably and at scale. Within this structure, Technology and Systems responsibilities are owned as a core operational capability, ensuring that digital infrastructure, tools, and access evolve in step with how the organization works.
* Systems and IT operations are designed to be
 *deeply integrated into day\-to\-day execution* 
 , preserving context across teams and workflows. The function works closely with Engineering to support research and development needs, and with Operations and Finance to ensure reliability, security, and long\-term sustainability.



  





**What You’ll Need to Do This Well** 



* Strong understanding of computer hardware and workstations: CPU, memory, storage, BIOS/firmware and
 *how configuration choices impact developer productivity and system reliability.*
* Deep familiarity with
 *office productivity and collaboration systems,* 
 and the ability to
 *design workflows that reduce friction and context switching* 
 rather than add process overhead.
* Solid grounding in
 *networking fundamentals* 
 (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls) relevant to office, lab, and inter\-office environments.
* Clear understanding of
 *device configuration, identity management, and user access policies, balancing usability with security.*
* Working knowledge of
 *security principles, data protection, and basic database concepts,* 
 sufficient to design safe and scalable internal systems.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 *DevOps or internal tooling infrastructure* 
 , especially in environments where tooling is still evolving.
* Experience setting up and maintaining databases or data services used internally by teams.
* Exposure to building IT systems in
 *fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environments where requirements change frequently.*
* *Experience supporting engineering\-heavy teams* 
 , including compute\-intensive workflows, development environments, and high\-performance workstations



  





**What will you do?** 



* You will design and operate the
 *digital infrastructure that enables CynLr’s teams to work without friction* 
 . Your role is to ensure that systems, tools, and access models support how people actually work across research, engineering, operations, and business functions.
* You will
 *translate organizational needs into reliable, secure, and intuitive IT systems, spanning devices, networks, collaboration tools, identity, and internal workflows* 
 . From onboarding a new team member to supporting compute\-heavy engineering setups, your work ensures that infrastructure never becomes the bottleneck to progress.
* You will proactively identify inefficiencies, hidden delays, and context\-switching costs in everyday workflows, and redesign systems to remove them so that teams can focus on solving hard problems, not fighting tools.



  





**How will you do it?** 



* The role demands a
 *systems\-first, entrepreneurial approach* 
 , suited to a deep\-tech environment where requirements evolve rapidly and standard enterprise playbooks often fall short.
* You will build strong context by working closely with teams, understanding how infrastructure decisions affect productivity, security, and reliability. You will question existing practices when they add friction, and design modular, scalable solutions that can adapt as CynLr grows.
* You will have the autonomy to rethink how systems are designed, deployed, and operated, with outcomes reviewed through the lens of
 *execution quality, reliability, usability, and long\-term sustainability.* 
 Success in this role comes from balancing hands\-on execution with thoughtful design solving today’s problems while building infrastructure that remains robust tomorrow.

 As a Consulting Engineer (G4\) within the SP Migration practice, you will be an active contributor to the full lifecycle of large\-scale Service Provider network migration projects. Working alongside senior technical leads, you will help accelerate customer business outcomes by supporting the design, configuration, testing, and execution of migrations across Cisco SP platforms. * Support the design and implementation of Service Provider network migrations, including platform upgrades, topology changes, and protocol transitions across Cisco IOS\-XR \& Nexus \-based router platforms (ASR, NCS, and Cisco 8K Series).

description:
Job Role: Level 2 Network Engineer (Operations Team)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Advanced Network Monitoring and Optimization:


 Oversee network performance, ensuring uptime and optimal configurations across Cisco Meraki, FortiGate, Cisco, any public cloud net ops, Cisco ISE and SD\-WAN environments.
   

  

 Manage Cisco ACI and Cisco Nexus environments, ensuring optimal performance and scalability.
   

  

 Identify, analyze, and resolve network performance bottlenecks and recommend enhancements.
   

  

 Monitor and maintain network health, proactively identifying and resolving issues related to ACI, Nexus switches, and routing.
   

  

* Complex Troubleshooting and Incident Resolution:


 Act as the escalation point for Level 1 engineers, resolving advanced incidents related to firewalls, DNS, Zscaler, SD\-WAN, and load balancers (NetScaler/F5\).
   

  

 Diagnose and resolve network\-related application issues, including advanced routing, S2S VPNs, and traffic shaping problems.
   

  

 Configure and troubleshoot BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) and OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) routing protocols within the network infrastructure.
   

  

 Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and provide actionable recommendations to prevent future occurrences.
   

  

 Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for network access control, device authentication, and security policy enforcement across the network.
   

  

* Network Configuration and Implementation:


 Design and implement advanced configurations for firewalls, load balancers, SD\-WAN, and Zscaler to meet business needs.
   

  

 Manage and maintain DNS records, including advanced configurations like load balancing, failover, and CDN integrations.
   

  

 Assist in planning and executing network upgrades, migrations, and deployments for multi\-site environments.
   

  

 Ensure high availability and redundancy of network components, including ACI fabric, Nexus switches, and routing protocols.
   

  

* Security and Compliance:


 Implement and manage complex firewall rules, VPNs.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with security standards, conducting regular audits and vulnerability assessments on network devices.
   

  

 Support Zscaler policy configuration and integration with other network security tools.
   

  

* Collaboration and Mentorship:


 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement network changes with minimal disruption.
   

  

 Mentor Level 1 engineers by providing training, guidance, and support to improve team skill levels.
   

  

 Liaise with vendors for escalated support, product updates, and feature enablement.
   

  

* Documentation and Reporting:


 Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for network infrastructure, configurations, and processes.
   

  

 Generate in\-depth reports on network performance, incident resolution, and system health for stakeholders.
   

  

 Maintain updated diagrams and records of network topology and architecture.
   

  

* Strategic Contributions:


 Participate in network architecture design discussions, providing insights and recommendations.
   

  

 Evaluate and recommend new tools, technologies, and processes to improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 Lead small\-scale projects involving network optimization, hardware refreshes, or policy implementations.
   

  

* Disaster Recovery and Backup:


 Manage backup and restoration processes for firewalls, DNS servers, load balancers, and SD\-WAN devices.
   

  

 Play a key role in disaster recovery planning and execution, ensuring rapid restoration of services.
   

  

**Skills And Qualifications**
 Technical Expertise:
   

  

 In\-depth experience with Cisco Meraki, FortiGate or CheckPoint or Cisco firewall.
   

  

 Strong expertise in Cisco ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure) and Cisco Nexus series switches.
   

  

 Proficiency in SD\-WAN technologies, including advanced routing and policy configurations.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Zscaler deployment and advanced policy management.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of load balancers like NetScaler and F5, including traffic steering and SSL offloading.
   

  

 In\-depth understanding and hands\-on experience with BGP and OSPF routing protocols.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for network access control and security policy enforcement.
   

  

**Tools And Platforms**
 Proficiency with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Wireshark)
   

  

 Familiarity with firewall management systems (e.g., FortiManager, Cisco FMC, ASDM) and SD\-WAN controllers.
   

  

**Certifications (Preferred)**
 CCNP, Fortinet NSE 5 or above, Zscaler ZCE, or equivalent.
   

  

 NetScaler certifications are an added advantage.
   

  

 Handle escalations and advanced troubleshooting that goes beyond routine issues.
   

  

 Take ownership of critical incidents and lead their resolution.
   

  

 Contribute to network design and improvement discussions.
   

  

 Mentor and upskill junior team members.
   

  

 Ensure systems are compliant with the latest security standards and best practices.

title: ML Engineer I
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. **What makes you qualified:**
* Degree in Computer Science or related quantitative field of relevant experience from Tier 1 colleges.
* At least 0\-1 years of Deep Learning Experience with a distinguished track record on technically fast paced projects.
* Familiarity with cloud deployment technologies, such as Kubernetes or Docker containers.
* Experience with large language models (GPT\-4, Pathways, Google Bert, Transformer) and deep learning tools (TensorFlow, Torch).
* Working experience of software engineering best practices including coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI, build processes, testing, and operations.
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and product management to understand requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs.


**Nice to have:**
* Experience in directly managing a team of high calibre machine learning engineers and data scientists.
* Experience with Multi\-Modal ML including Generative AI.
* Interested in and thoughtful about the impacts of AI technology.
* A real passion for AI!


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

title: RC - REGULATORY COMPLIANCE - Lab Digitisation - BA - Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY – GDS Consulting – Enterprise Risk (ER) – Regulatory Compliance –Manager –** 
**LABS – Business Analyst**
 As part of our EY\-ER\- Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines \& methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance Manager actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you’ll consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in Laboratory Digitalisation to lead regulatory strategy and IT\-enabled transformation initiatives in regulated GxP environments. This role requires strong consulting skills, industry knowledge, and the ability to translate regulatory strategy into scalable, compliant solutions for global clients.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Manager at Regulatory Compliance, you will lead Digital Laboratory initiatives in regulated GxP environments, leveraging your deep expertise in Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Laboratory Notebooks (ELN), Laboratory Execution Systems (LES), and strong consulting capabilities.
   

  

 Your primary responsibility will be to partner with clients to understand their laboratory business needs and translate strategic objectives into integrated, compliant, and practical digital lab solutions. You will play a pivotal role in establishing and nurturing relationships across internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment with EY’s commitment to data integrity, quality, and regulatory compliance.
   

  

 This is a leadership role that demands strategic thinking, strong stakeholder engagement, and a passion for delivering excellence across complex laboratory operations in a highly regulated environment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client Responsibilities**
* Lead and oversee Digital Lab initiatives, including LIMS, ELN, and LES implementations, upgrades, and optimizations in regulated laboratory environments
* Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements for LIMS implementations/enhancements (LabWare, Benchling, STARLIMS), translating laboratory processes into functional specifications and user stories.
* Act as the bridge between business and technical teams, ensuring accurate mapping of lab workflows (sample management, testing, stability, reporting) into system configurations and solution designs.
* Drive process optimization and standardization by identifying gaps, redundancies, and improvement opportunities across laboratory operations and aligning with industry best practices.
* Support system implementation and validation activities by defining test scenarios, coordinating UAT, ensuring traceability, and maintaining compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and data integrity requirements.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement and change management through workshops, training, documentation, and user support to drive adoption of LIMS solutions across labs.Partner with clients to understand laboratory operations and translate business and compliance requirements into integrated digital lab solutions and their respective configurations
* Drive requirements gathering, system configuration, data migration, and integrations across lab systems, instruments, and enterprise platforms
* Ensure data integrity, traceability, and compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and internal SOPs
* Guide clients through CSV / CSA / risk‑based validation activities for digital lab systems
* Support audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments related to laboratory systems
* Identify opportunities for process harmonization, standardization, and digital enablement across laboratories


**People Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and mentor Digital Lab consultants, validation analysts, and technical team members
* Manage work allocation across LIMS, ELN, and LES engagements, ensuring quality delivery and adherence to timelines
* Conduct performance reviews, feedback, and development planning
* Build and strengthen Digital Lab and laboratory systems capabilities within the team
* Support hiring, onboarding, training, and knowledge‑transfer initiatives
* Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement


**Decision\-Making Responsibilities:**
* Make informed decisions on delivery approach, validation strategy, and risk mitigation for digital lab programs
* Assess system, data, and compliance risks and proactively escalate issues to clients and EY leadership
* Support leadership in workforce planning, solution design, and practice development for Digital Lab offerings
* Guide decisions on vendor coordination, system design tradeoffs, and implementation timelines
* Apply structured and analytical thinking to improve delivery efficiency and client outcomes.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Contribute to business development, proposals, and client presentations related to Digital Lab initiatives
* Support inspection readiness, mock audits, and CAPA activities
* Stay current with regulatory expectations, industry trends, and emerging digital lab technologies
* Promote adoption of automation, analytics, and innovation within laboratory operations
* Collaborate with Quality, IT, Regulatory, and Manufacturing teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Uphold EY’s standards for ethics, quality, and compliance.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding of regulated laboratory environments and quality‑driven operations
* Ability to identify process gaps, operational risks, and improvement opportunities
* Structured and analytical approach to problem‑solving and decision‑making
* Strong stakeholder and client‑management skills
* Ability to work effectively in global, cross‑functional teams
* Leadership mindset with the ability to guide teams and influence outcomes
* Consulting orientation balancing compliance, pragmatism, and delivery excellence
* High attention to detail with awareness of the broader business and compliance context
* Openness to digital transformation and innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 8–12 years of experience in Digital Lab, LIMS, ELN, LES, or regulated laboratory systems
* Proven experience leading or supporting digital lab implementations, upgrades, or validation initiatives
* Experience working in regulated GxP environments, supporting audits and inspections
* Demonstrated experience managing teams, vendors, or complex stakeholders
* Strong documentation discipline and familiarity with controlled quality systems
* Ability to operate at a managerial level, balancing delivery and people leadership


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Certifications such as Labware Configuration, Sample Manager developer, Computer System Validation (CSV/CSA), or Project Management Professional (PMP).
* Experience with global or multi\-site digital laboratory implementations, upgrades, and inspection\-readiness activities.
* Familiarity with emerging technologies in laboratory operations, including automation, analytics, and AI/ML\-enabled solutions.
* Knowledge of data integrity principles, electronic records and signatures, and structured laboratory data management.
* Experience with industry\-leading digital lab platforms such as LabWare, SampleManager, STARLIMS, Benchling, or equivalent systems.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Business Analyst – Atlassian Cloud Migration (Testing,  Deployment, Hypercare)
description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Atlassian Business Analyst with a strong focus on testing, UAT
   

  

 coordination, deployment planning, and Hypercare execution to support a strategic migration
   

  

 from Atlassian Data Center to Atlassian Cloud (Jira and Confluence). This role is central to
   

  

 ensuring a high\-quality, well\-governed, and minimally disruptive transition for our engineering,
   

  

 IT, and business teams. You will own the end\-to\-end testing lifecycle, lead UAT coordination
   

  

 and execution, drive defect triage and reporting, and serve as a key orchestrator of deployment
   

  

 and Hypercare activities — while acting as a critical liaison between technical teams,
   

  

 stakeholders, and vendors.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Testing Strategy \& Execution
* Define, own, and execute a comprehensive end\-to\-end testing strategy across all migration


 phases, including functional, regression, integration, and smoke testing
   

  

* Develop detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts aligned to migration scope, integration


 dependencies, and business\-critical workflows
   

  

* Coordinate and execute testing across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and


 Confluence — validating workflows, schemes, permissions, project configurations, and
   

  

 Marketplace app functionality in the Cloud environment
   

  

* Validate that all integrations (CI/CD pipelines, REST API consumers, third\-party apps) are


 functioning as expected post\-migration
   

  

* Maintain a centralized test case repository and ensure traceability from requirements through


 test execution and sign\-off
   

  

* UAT Coordination \& Execution
* Serve as the primary coordinator for all UAT activities, managing scheduling, participant


 onboarding, environment readiness, and execution tracking
   

  

* Partner with business stakeholders, integration owners, and platform teams to define UAT


 scope, entry/exit criteria, and acceptance standards
   

  

* Facilitate UAT sessions, providing guidance and real\-time support to testers throughout


 execution cycles
   

  

* Track UAT progress against plan, proactively identifying blockers and escalating risks to keep


 execution on schedule
   

  

* Obtain and document formal UAT sign\-off from stakeholders prior to go\-live authorization
* .
* Defect Triage, Tracking \& Reporting
* Lead defect triage sessions, facilitating prioritization discussions with technical and business


 stakeholders to assess severity, impact, and resolution ownership
   

  

* Maintain a structured defect log (in Jira), ensuring all issues are clearly documented with


 reproduction steps, severity ratings, ownership, and resolution status
   

  

* Produce regular testing status reports and defect dashboards for project leadership, surfacing


 trends, blockers, and go/no\-go risk indicators
   

  

* Track defects through the full lifecycle — from identification through resolution, retest, and


 closure — ensuring nothing falls through the cracks
   

  

* Define and enforce defect SLAs in alignment with migration risk thresholds and go\-live criteria
* .


 s7 Deployment Planning \& Execution
   

  

* Collaborate with technical leads and project managers to develop detailed deployment plans,


 including cutover sequencing, task ownership, timing windows, and dependency mapping
   

  

* Maintain and manage cutover runbooks and checklists, ensuring all pre\-cutover, during\-


 cutover, and post\-cutover steps are clearly defined and assigned
   

  

* Develop and maintain rollback plans with clearly defined trigger criteria and execution steps
* Coordinate with Atlassian, third\-party vendors, and internal platform teams during migration


 execution windows to ensure smooth, on\-plan delivery
   

  

* Track deployment task completion in real time during cutover events, flagging deviations and


 driving rapid decision\-making
   

  

* )
* Hypercare Planning \& Execution
* Design and own the Hypercare plan, defining support coverage models, escalation paths,


 monitoring checkpoints, and issue response SLAs for the post\-go\-live stabilization period
   

  

* Serve as the Hypercare execution lead, coordinating daily standups, issue intake, triage, and


 resolution tracking during the stabilization window
   

  

* Monitor system health, integration performance, and user\-reported issues in real time following


 migration go\-live
   

  

* Produce daily Hypercare status reports summarizing open issues, resolution progress, user


 impact, and overall system stability
   

  

* Define and manage the criteria for Hypercare exit, ensuring all critical issues are resolved and


 stakeholders formally acknowledge transition to steady\-state support –? Planning, Risk \& Dependency Management
   

  

* Maintain a RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) with a focus on testing and


 deployment risks
   

  

* Identify and escalate blockers that could impact UAT completion, deployment readiness, or


 Hypercare stability
   

  

* Collaborate with integration owners to ensure all connected systems are included in test scope


 and deployment sequencing
   

  

* Support go/no\-go decision\-making by providing clear, data\-driven readiness assessments


 based on testing outcomes and open defect status
   

  

* )
* Documentation \& Reporting
* Create and maintain migration documentation including test plans, UAT coordination guides,


 defect triage logs, deployment runbooks, cutover checklists, and Hypercare playbooks
   

  

* Develop stakeholder\-facing status reports and dashboards that translate technical testing and


 deployment details into clear, actionable insights
   

  

* Ensure all documentation is version\-controlled and kept current throughout all migration


 phases
   

  

* Post\-Migration Optimization User Training: Updating documentation and training users on the


 differences between Data Center and Cloud functionality.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or QA/Testing Coordinator, with at least 2\+


 years focused on Atlassian platforms (Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence)
   

  

* Demonstrated experience leading UAT coordination and execution on large\-scale platform


 migrations or enterprise system implementations
   

  

* Proven track record managing defect triage processes, including logging, prioritization,


 tracking, and reporting through resolution
   

  

* Experience developing and executing deployment runbooks, cutover plans, and rollback


 strategies
   

  

* Hands\-on experience designing and executing Hypercare support models for post\-go\-live


 stabilization
   

  

* Strong proficiency with Jira for defect tracking and reporting (dashboards, filters, and custom


 reports)
   

  

* Experience with Atlassian Data Center to Cloud migrations or large\-scale Atlassian platform


 upgrades, Specifically the differences in API and functionality between Data Center and Cloud
   

  

* Strong understanding of Jira and Confluence administration, including workflows, schemes,


 permissions, and project configurations
   

  

* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to


 drive accountability across cross\-functional teams
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with Atlassian Cloud migration tools (Jira Cloud Migration Assistant, Confluence


 Cloud Migration Assistant)
   

  

* Experience with enterprise SSO/SAML integrations (Okta) in the context of Atlassian Cloud


 testing and validation
   

  

* Knowledge of Atlassian Access / Guard and cloud security/governance features
* Background in ITSM or DevOps environments
* Experience working in a cybersecurity or high\-compliance technology environment
* Familiarity with tools such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, GitLab, Jenkins, Slack, or similar that


 commonly integrate with Jira/Confluence
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* A structured, execution\-focused approach to managing complex testing and deployment


 workstreams in a fast\-moving enterprise environment
   

  

* The ability to drive accountability across stakeholders, testers, and technical teams to keep


 UAT and deployment activities on track
   

  

* A sharp eye for defect patterns and risk signals, translating testing data into clear go/no\-go


 recommendations for leadership
   

  

* A proactive, calm\-under\-pressure mindset — especially during high\-stakes cutover and


 Hypercare windows
   

  

* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, security\-focused enterprise environment where precision


 and reliability are non\-negotiable

 : Chennai, India
   

  

 ASSA ABLOY Group is a global leader in access solutions, powering secure identities for millions worldwide. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment where creativity, learning, and career growth are encouraged.
   

  

 Are you ready for a new challenge in IT? Join our Group IT Infrastructure Advisory team as an Infrastructure Solutions Advisor in Chennai and play a pivotal role in guiding customers through the adoption, migration, and management of IT infrastructure services. You will act as the bridge between business needs and technology solutions, ensuring our products and services align with organizational objectives and deliver real business outcomes.
   

  

**What Would You Do As Our Infrastructure Solutions Advisor**

* Lead our journey of Continuous Product improvements: collect and refine customer ideas, conduct signoffs with divisions.
* Gather stakeholder requirements, translate into actionable features, and define key product metrics.
* Advise teams on designing, building, and deploying secure, scalable IT infrastructure (cloud, networking, storage, security).
* Collaborating with all internal Group IT Teams to provide customer success using all products


**The Skills And Experience You Need**
 We are looking for someone who:
   

  

* Can sell our solutions, guide customers to the best decisions, and collaborate with solution architects to create optimal solutions.
* Has a strong IT infrastructure background, probably Infrastructure Solutions Advisor or equal (cloud, virtualization, networking, databases).
* Communicates complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences and understands Agile principles.
* Can influence without formal authority, advising and guiding teams, working proactively and independently.
* International Travel might be needed, experience in a global organization, and speaks English at a professional level.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Hands\-on experience designing and operating enterprise infrastructure across cloud and on\-prem environments (compute, storage, network, identity, security).
* Proven customer\-facing advisory experience: discovery, solutioning, migration planning, adoption, and success measurement.
* Strong understanding of security\-by\-design, compliance, and risk management for infrastructure services.
* Experience with service management and operational readiness (incident/problem/change, monitoring, SLOs/SLAs).
* Ability to translate business goals into technical requirements, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience working in Agile/DevOps ways of working and collaborating with product, engineering, and operations teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture, infrastructure consulting, or a similar role supporting complex enterprise environments.
* Relevant certifications are a plus (e.g., Azure/AWS/GCP, ITIL, TOGAF, Security certifications such as AZ\-500/SC\-200/SC\-300 or equivalent).
* Demonstrated ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels, including technical teams and business leadership.
* Professional fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required.

Oracle PBCS Consultant with 7\+ years of end\-to\-end implementation and support experience across planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting. The ideal candidate will design and build PBCS models, lead client workshops, integrate PBCS with ERP/HR systems, and deliver reliable planning solutions with robust data governance and performance tuning.


\-

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design \& Delivery**

* Lead requirement workshops and translate financial planning needs into scalable PBCS/EPM Cloud solutions.
* Design and build Planning models (Workforce, CapEx, OpEx, Revenue, Project Planning) using EPMA/Standard Planning, Data Forms, Smart Lists, and Business Rules.
* Develop Calculation Manager rules (Groovy/Business Rules) and driver\-based models for scenario, version, and year planning.

**Data \& Integration**

* Orchestrate data loads (files, APIs), validate data quality, and monitor integration jobs.
* Implement dimension management (hierarchies), metadata updates, and substitution variables.

**Reporting \& Analytics**

* Develop executive\-ready reports in Oracle Reports, Dashboards, Infolets, and Smart View (Excel/Office).
* Build variance analyses, driver\-based KPIs, and board\-level reporting packs.
* Enable ad\-hoc analysis and self\-service reporting for Finance users.

**Governance, Performance \& Support**

* Establish design standards, documentation, and testing cycles (SIT, UAT).
* Optimize performance (rule tuning, form design, caching), troubleshoot issues, and drive root\-cause analysis.
* Provide hypercare, user training, and ongoing support; manage enhancements via change control.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manage delivery scope, risks, and timelines; contribute to effort estimation and project planning.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications**

o Planning Artifacts: Forms, Rules (Groovy/Calc Manager), Approvals, Validations, Smart Lists, Sub Vars.


o Data Management/Integrations: Mappings, Load Rules, Drill\-through, Integration Agent.


o Reporting: Smart View, Dashboards, and Financial Data modeling.

* Solid understanding of FP\&A processes: Annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, rolling forecast, scenario modeling, allocations, intercompany eliminations, currency translations.
* Proficiency in SQL/CSV data handling, and performance tuning within PBCS.
* Experience with requirements gathering, solution design, and conducting UAT/training.
* Excellent communication skills and client\-facing experience.

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**

  

* Groovy scripting for advanced business rules.
* Integration exposure to Oracle Fusion ERP/EBS/SAP (GL, Projects, HR).
* Knowledge of REST APIs for EPM Cloud automation.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery and DevOps practices for EPM deployments.

**Tools \& Technologies**

* Oracle EPM Cloud (PBCS/EPBCS), Calculation Manager, Groovy.
* Smart View (Excel plugin), Data Management, Integration Agent.
* SQL/Excel, REST APIs, Jira/Confluence, MS Teams.

  

**Additional Information**

**Position Title \- Finance Manager** 

**Department \- Finance \& Accounts**

**Experience Required \- 8 – 12 Years**

**Industry Preference \- Construction / Architecture / Interior Design / Real Estate**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and result\-oriented Finance Manager with 8–12 years of experience in the construction, architecture, and interior design industry. The candidate will be responsible for managing the overall financial operations of the organization, leading the finance team, ensuring financial compliance, budgeting, cost control, project finance management, and supporting strategic business decisions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, financial planning expertise, and experience in handling project\-based financial operations within the construction and design sector.

**Key Duties \& Responsibilities**

**1\*.** Financial Planning \& Budget Management\*

Prepare annual budgets, financial forecasts, and project cost plans.

Monitor organizational financial performance and control project expenditures.

Analyze budget variances and recommend corrective actions.

Support management with strategic financial planning and decision\-making.

**2\. Accounting \& Financial Operations**

Oversee daily accounting operations, bookkeeping, and financial transactions.

Ensure accurate maintenance of ledgers, invoices, payments, and financial records.

Review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

Manage cash flow, banking operations, and fund utilization efficiently.

**3\. Project Finance \& Cost Control**

Monitor project\-wise costing, profitability, and financial performance.

Ensure proper tracking of construction and interior project expenses.

Control operational costs and optimize financial resources.

Coordinate with project teams regarding project budgets and financial approvals.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Management**

Lead, supervise, and manage the finance and accounts team effectively.

Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of financial tasks.

Provide guidance, performance monitoring, and team development support.

Ensure coordination between finance, procurement, HR, and project departments.

**5\. Compliance \& Audit Management**

Ensure compliance with financial regulations, taxation, and statutory requirements.

Handle GST, TDS, payroll compliance, and other financial statutory processes.

Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely audit closure.

Maintain proper financial documentation and compliance records.

**6\. Reporting \& Financial Analysis**

Prepare MIS reports, financial dashboards, and management reports.

Present financial insights and profitability analysis to senior management.

Monitor financial risks and recommend process improvements.

Ensure accurate reporting of project revenue, expenses, and cash flow.

**7\. Vendor \& Payment Management**

Monitor vendor payments, subcontractor billing, and payment schedules.

Verify payment approvals as per project and financial policies.

Maintain healthy financial relationships with vendors and suppliers.

Ensure proper reconciliation of accounts payable and receivable.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial management.

Expertise in project finance, budgeting, and cost control.

Knowledge of GST, taxation, statutory compliance, and audit procedures.

Strong analytical, leadership, and decision\-making skills.

Excellent communication and team management abilities.

Proficiency in Tally, ERP systems, MS Excel, and financial reporting tools.

**Educational Qualification**

CA / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com with relevant experience.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Experience in construction, architecture, interior design, or project\-based industries.

Ability to manage multiple projects and financial operations simultaneously.

Strong leadership experience in handling finance and accounts teams.

High attention to detail, confidentiality, and organizational skills.

title: Director Of Engineering (Site Lead) - Spend Team
description:
**About Rippling**


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

### **About The Role**


We’re building a world\-class Spend org in Bangalore and looking for a senior engineering leader to serve as our local site lead while directly owning the Accounting Integrations team. This is a rare 0 to 1 plus scale role: you’ll stand up the Bangalore hub, hire and coach managers and ICs, and ship the accounting integration platform that powers Rippling’s finance suite (corporate cards, reimbursements, travel, and accounting automation).

  

You’ll wear two hats:

* Site Lead (matrix): Be the senior presence for Spend in Bangalore—set a high bar, unblock teams, drive performance management, and ensure crisp product\<\>engineering execution across reimbursements, travel integrations, and accounting integrations.
* Direct Owner (line): Lead the Accounting Integrations team to build both the platform and the first wave of integrations (e.g., QuickBooks, Microsoft, and others). You’ll create repeatable pipelines, operational tooling, and the quality bar for how Rippling ships integrations.

  

If you thrive on ownership, love building teams and systems, and want material impact on a product with massive TAM, this is for you.

 **Why this role?**

  

* 0 to 1 with leverage: Your platform unlocks multiple product lines (Spend, Travel, Payroll).
* Massive scope: Travel \+ Spend are multibillion\-dollar markets; integrations are a core growth lever.
* Career runway: Build the Bangalore Spend org from the ground up and shape the architecture and culture that others scale

 **What You'll Do**

* Build the Bangalore hub: Hire, level, and grow a 25\+ person org; stand up rituals, on\-call, quality bars, and velocity tracking.
* Own Accounting Integrations end\-to\-end: Define the technical roadmap and delivery plan for an integrations platform that serves both Spend and Payroll; ship the next set of GA integrations.
* Raise the execution bar: Diagnose churn early, clarify requirements, and drive PR/Design quality; get teams shipping the right thing, fast.
* Manage managers \+ ICs: Mentor junior EMs; directly manage ICs initially and transition scope as leaders ramp.
* Operational excellence: Build support and observability for integrations (routing, retries, idempotency, reconciliation, data quality, SLAs).
* Partner deeply: Work with Product, Design, GTM, and Finance Ops to prioritize impact, measure outcomes, and iterate quickly.
* Scale through platforms: Establish reusable contracts, SDKs, tooling, and CI/CD standards so new integrations land in weeks—not quarters.
* Be the site leader: Set crisp goals, run calibration, address underperformance fast, and model hands\-on, detail\-oriented leadership.

### **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years in engineering leadership, including 2\+ years managing managers or large multi\-team groups
* Proven 0 to 1 and scale experience: shipped platforms or integrations with high reliability and throughput
* You like being technical. Strong technical depth in distributed systems, APIs/webhooks, and data modeling. Comfortable reviewing designs and PRs
* Operational mindset: built systems with monitoring, alerting, rate limits, retries, reconciliation, and clear SLOs/SLAs
* People leader: hires great talent, levels accurately, runs calibrations, manages performance with candor and speed
* Product sense: You can turn ambiguous requirements into shipped outcomes while balancing speed with quality
* Nice to have: prior work with accounting/ERP systems, travel content providers, or financial data flows

title: HR manager
description:
Job description

HR Executive Supermarket Candidates (Only Apply)

Reporting To: MD

We are looking for a Professional Human Resources Executive for Leading Supermarket shop.

Qualification: MBA or MSW (or Any Degree)\_

Experience Required: 3 to 5 Years in HR profile especially in HR supermarket.

responsibilities include recruiting and training new hires, managing employee data and taking steps to retain our people. To be successful in this role, you should have a good knowledge of labor legislation and experience hiring employees for various roles and seniority levels.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:1\. Recruitment \& Onboarding

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment process: job postings, screening resumes, conducting interviews, and issuing offer letters.
* Coordinate onboarding, induction, and documentation for new hires.
* Maintain and update employee database and personnel files.

2\. Attendance \& Payroll Support

* Monitor attendance, leave records, and coordinate with accounts/payroll for timely salary processing.
* Manage biometric systems and resolve related issues.

3\. Employee Engagement \& Communication

* Organize employee engagement activities and internal events.
* Serve as a communication bridge between management and staff.
* Handle grievance redressal and support conflict resolution.

4\. Compliance \& Record\-Keeping

* Ensure compliance with labor laws (PF, ESI, etc.) and dealership policies.
* Prepare and submit required HR\-related reports (statutory and internal).
* Maintain confidentiality of all employee records.

5\. Training \& Development

* Coordinate with managers for identifying training needs.
* Schedule and maintain records of training programs.

6\. Exit Formalities

* Manage resignation, clearance, and full \& final settlement processes.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyze attrition data.

Key Skills Required:

* Strong understanding of HR practices and labor laws
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in MS Office \& HRMS software
* Good organizational and multitasking abilities

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources / Business Administration / related field (MBA preferred)
* 3–5 years of HR experience (Supermarket Industry Experience)

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

**About Us**
------------



Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.


From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity\-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.


**Grow a Career. Build a Future!**


Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------



1\. National Sales Planning \& Forecasting


* Lead AOP (Annual Operating Plan) and rolling forecasts at national level


* Design target allocation frameworks across states, clusters, and territories


* Ensure alignment of targets with market potential, seasonality, and business priorities


* Monitor performance vs plan and recommend strategic interventions

  



2\. Sales Incentive Plan (SIP) – Design \& Governance

* Define clear KPIs, payout structures, slabs, and eligibility criteria


* Ensure SIP drives:



1\. Business growth



2\. Market share improvement



3\. Focus on priority products / geographies


* Track SIP effectiveness, payout vs performance correlation


* Continuously refine plans based on behavioral outcomes and business impact

  



Role Manager / Senior Manager – Sales Planning \& Operations



Department/Brand Tractor Sales



Location Greater Noida



Reports to Director Sales



3\. Scheme Strategy, Rollout \& Actualisation


* Conceptualize and deploy national and channel schemes


* Ensure structured rollout communication and execution timelines


* Monitor actualisation vs scheme intent and budget utilization


* Provide insights on scheme ROI and market competitiveness

  



4\. DMS Governance \& Digital Discipline


* Drive national governance of Dealer Management System (DMS)



Ensure:



1\. Data accuracy



2\. Timely data entry



3\. Billing discipline



4\. Stock visibility


* Define KPIs and track dealer/system compliance levels


* Partner with IT for system enhancements and adoption

  



5\. Sales MIS \& Business Analytics


* Develop and standardize central MIS dashboards and reporting frameworks


* Provide actionable insights on:



1\. Retail vs billing gap



2\. Market share trends



3\. Scheme and SIP performance



4\. Dealer funding \& inventory health


* Enable leadership with data\-backed decision\-making tools

  



6\. Sales Organization Planning \& Productivity


* Design and optimize sales structure and manpower deployment


* Define span of control, coverage norms, and productivity benchmarks


* Identify gaps in coverage, capability, and performance


* Work with HR on hiring plans, KRAs, and performance management frameworks
**Experience Required**
-----------------------


* Graduate / MBA (preferred)


* 10–18\+ years in sales planning / incentive design / sales operations


* Experience in automobile / tractor / rural markets preferred


* Prior exposure to Head Office / Central roles
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Graduate / MBA (preferred)


* 10–18\+ years in sales planning / incentive design / sales operations


* Experience in automobile / tractor / rural markets preferred


* Prior exposure to Head Office / Central roles
**Job Purpose**
---------------



To drive centralized sales planning, incentive strategy, performance governance, and system\-led execution across regions by designing robust frameworks for target setting, sales incentives (SIP), scheme effectiveness, MIS, and organization productivity, enabling consistent and profitable growth.

**What We Offer**
-----------------



We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.


At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:

title: Team Leader
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.



A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."



* Location
Bengaluru
* Employment type
Full Time Permanent
* Department
People \& HR
* Deadline
2026\-06\-09

  
Candidate profile (title) Who you are
Candidate profile (text) \- Default language About you
  

  

Are you passionate about exceeding goals and fostering team success? Do you thrive in a fast\-paced, multi\-national environment? Are you eager to contribute to a company that prioritizes bettering everyday life for many people? If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team.
  

  

We're seeking a candidate with a strong foundation in HR with minimum 12\+ years of experience, particularly in payroll and personnel administration (PA/PY), coupled with an advanced understanding of pay\-the\-worker processes. Alongside this expertise, familiarity with HR\-related tax and legal matters is essential.
  

  

A comprehensive understanding of the IKEA HR system landscape is a definite advantage, as is proficiency in modern office practices, procedures, and equipment. While a basic understanding of the IKEA system is required, we're also looking for candidates who demonstrate potential management or leadership skills, as this role may involve guiding and leading teams toward shared objectives.
  

  

You
  

  

* have passion for working with people and you successfully lead them by example,
* communication in English is your strong point, and you are eager to use it while cooperating with various partners all over the world
* bring a true passion for people and enjoy working in a vibrant and changing environment,
* thrive in a dynamic, fast\-changing environment and are passionate about transitions and driving change.
* have a service oriented and customer focused background, a strong drive and the ability to take decisions and delegate,
* have understanding and passion for IKEA values and want to share it with your team.
* have strong knowledge of HR Processes (including Payroll) (with min. 5 years of experience) preferably IN (India) HR processes and with min 3\-5yrs of People Manager experience.
* build strong relationships and collaborate easily with different stakeholders
* are well\-organized, proactive, and able to prioritize effectively

  

Last, but not least – you are a true ambassador for IKEA Culture and Values.
Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us
Key responsibilities (text) As the leader of a GBO People Services team, you're responsible to lead one of the GBO People Services teams for India, which is responsible for P\&C processes (Personnel Administration, Payroll, Recruitment, Onboarding, Offboarding, Benefits, Learning and Development) as per defined and agreed scope, execute delivery of services on high professional standard and strive to meet or exceed agreed service levels.
  

  

As a People Services Team Leader you will:
  

* Lead the country Personnel Administration/Payroll team to deliver high\-quality services efficiently, including monthly and yearly activities.
* To ensure efficient and high\-quality PA/PY service delivery in line with global procedures and local legal requirements.
* Adhere to defined KPIs/SLAs.
* Act as an expert, leading solution implementation.
* Develop team competence through coaching and training.
* Resolve issues, manage escalations, and follow up on outstanding topics in promptly and a timely manner.
* Drive continuous process improvement.
* Closely cooperate with Project Leader to secure migration plan for any transferring/transitioning services.
* Active participation \& coordination in relevant project deliverables
* Foster strong relationships with partners.
* Allocate resources effectively and create a motivated, high\-performing team environment
* Manage, coach, and develop team members, strengthening their knowledge, skills, and engagement.
* Recruit and onboard competent new co\-workers that will fit the team with the required PA/PY profiles
* Motivate the team to deliver outstanding service.
* Promote a culture where IKEA values are a strong and visible part of everyday work.
* Actively contributes to project deliverables and foster strong relationships with stakeholders.

This role is situated within Bangalore and will report directly to the GBO Service Delivery Manager or GBO People Services Manager for India. Also, this role requires working from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM to support India customers, with the flexibility to extend working hours when needed.
Team vision ( title) About this work area
Team vision (text) Global Business Operation (GBO) is a function within the IKEA Group of companies. We work with transactional services in the field of Finance and HR. We deliver our services through our regional hubs, located in Poznan, Shanghai, Bangalore and Baltimore.
### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home\-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.  

  

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co\-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.  

  

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.
### **What we all have in common**


* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing \& delivering while learning \& developing
* Having fun!

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description**
  

 Globus is a leading global producer of release liners, dedicated to serving the pressure\-sensitive adhesives industry with high\-quality products. With over 30 years of expertise in silicone coating, Globus exports to more than 55 countries. Equipped with advanced technology, solvent\-less silicone coating and slitting lines, the company can produce and customize liners across various sizes and formats. Annually, Globus has the capacity to coat up to 350 million square meters of paper and film, showcasing its commitment to efficiency and excellence.
   

  

**Role Description**
  

 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Human Resources Manager at Globus, based in Khopoli. The HR Manager will oversee all HR functions, including recruitment, employee relations, training and development, and compliance with employment laws. Responsibilities include managing payroll, implementing HR policies, fostering a positive workplace culture, handling performance evaluations, and addressing employee concerns. The HR Manager will also work closely with department heads to align HR strategies with organizational goals.
   

  

**Qualifications**
  

* Proficiency in Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, and Workforce Planning
* Strong understanding of Employee Relations, Conflict Resolution, and HR Policies
* Expertise in Training, Learning \& Development, and Performance Management
* Knowledge of Compliance, Employment Laws, and Regulatory Standards
* Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
* Proficiency in HR Management Software and Microsoft Office Suite
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Prior experience in manufacturing or industrial sectors is a plus

title: Flutter Developer Intern
description:
Are you a builder who learns by doing? Do you spend your free time tinkering with code, breaking things, and fixing them just to see how they work? If so, we want to talk to you.

We are looking for a motivated **Mobile App Developer** with a passion for **Flutter and Kotlin** to join our team in a flexible, internship\-style collaboration. We don’t care about a perfect 5\-page corporate resume or decades of formal job experience. **We care about your ability to build real, functioning software.**

Whether you are a student, a self\-taught developer, a recent graduate, or an engineer transitioning from another stack—if you have a GitHub repository full of experimental projects, freelance work, or college apps you are proud of, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)**

As a core contributor to our mobile ecosystem, you won't just be fetching coffee or doing mindless data entry. You will be treating this like a real product ownership role. You will:

* **Build \& Iterate:** Develop, test, and deploy new mobile app features using Flutter and Kotlin.
* **Craft UI/UX:** Translate design wireframes into smooth, responsive, and pixel\-perfect user interfaces.
* **Connect Systems:** Integrate backend services, RESTful APIs, and cloud databases (like Firebase).
* **Debug \& Optimize:** Hunt down bugs, profile app performance, and continuously iterate based on user feedback.
* **Influence Product:** Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute directly to product development decisions. Your voice matters here.

**Our Tech Stack**

* **Core:** Flutter with Web support (Dart) \& Backend (Kotlin)
* **Plus Skills (Nice to have):** Firebase ecosystem, REST APIs, Git/Version Control, and general Flutter knowledge.

**Who You Are (Requirements)**

We are looking for a specific mindset rather than a specific degree. You are a great fit if you possess:

* **Hands\-on Building Ability:** You have already built and deployed (or at least run locally) real projects.
* **High Curiosity \& Ownership:** You don't just wait for instructions. You look at a problem, research solutions, and take ownership of the outcome.
* **Independent Problem\-Solving:** You are comfortable digging through documentation, Stack Overflow, or AI tools to unblock yourself when you get stuck.
* **Consistency:** Because this is a remote and flexible role, you must be a disciplined self\-starter who can communicate effectively and hit agreed\-upon milestones.

*This Role is Ideal For:*

* **Students \& Freshers** looking for high\-impact, real\-world development exposure to supercharge their portfolios.
* **Self\-Taught Developers** who need a platform to prove their skills on a production\-level app.
* **Engineers Transitioning** from web or backend development into the mobile space.

What We Offer

* **True Flexibility:** Work from anywhere, at any time that suits your schedule, provided deadlines are met.
* **Mentorship \& Growth:** Work on real\-world problems that will teach you more in a few months than a year in a lecture hall.
* **Portfolio Building:** Ship code that you can actually point to and say, *"I built that feature."*

**How to Apply**

To skip the corporate red tape, please include the following in your application:

* A link to your **GitHub profile, portfolio, or specific app repositories** (Applications without code samples will not be considered).
* A brief summary or links to **projects you’ve built** and what your role was in creating them.
* A **short introduction** about yourself, your coding journey, and why you want to work with Flutter/Kotlin.
* Your **current availability** (how many hours per week you can consistently dedicate to this collaboration).

Pay: From ₹4,000\.00 per month

**Experience:**

* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

description:
**Job Title:** Customer Support \& Operations Executive  
**Company:** KNV Ventures (parent company of a growing Indian D2C brand)  
**Location:** Remote \- India  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month **Experience:** 0–2 years (freshers welcome)

**About Us**

KNV Ventures is the parent company behind a fast\-growing Indian D2C health brand. We sell health supplements directly to customers across India and we're scaling quickly. As we grow, we need someone to own customer support and day\-to\-day operations so our customers always have a smooth experience.

→ To apply, you must fill out our short application form (link at the bottom). Applications without the form will not be reviewed.

**Role Overview**

We're hiring a Customer Support \& Operations Executive who will be the main point of contact for our customers and the person who keeps our orders moving smoothly.

On the support side, you'll help customers with all their questions, whether it's about the product itself or about their order. Most of this happens over WhatsApp and email, with the occasional inbound call (call volume is low, so this is a small part of the role). Customers will ask things like how the product works, when their parcel will arrive, or why a delivery is delayed, and you'll guide them clearly and patiently across whichever channel they reach out on.

On the operations side, you'll manage the shipping side of things end to end. This means handling NDRs (non\-delivery reports), managing RTO (return to origin) orders, raising and tracking tickets on shipping aggregator platforms, and coordinating with courier partners. Since you're already the one talking to customers, you'll also keep them updated on their order status and resolve any delivery issues directly with them.

In short, you'll own both the conversation with the customer and the journey of their order, making sure both run smoothly from start to finish.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Fluent in English and Hindi, comfortable communicating clearly over WhatsApp, email, and the occasional call
* Strong written communication, you can explain things simply and politely in text
* Organized and detail\-oriented, able to juggle support conversations and shipping tasks at the same time
* Calm and patient when handling customer concerns or delivery issues
* Has a laptop/computer, stable internet, and a quiet workspace
* Available to work 10 AM – 7 PM IST, Monday to Saturday
* Available to start within 7–10 days

**Nice to Have (Not Required)**

* Experience with Shopify
* Experience with shipping tools (Shiprocket, Delhivery One, iThink Logistics, Nimbuspost)
* Experience with WhatsApp tools (Zoko, KwikEngage, Interakt, Wati)
* Prior customer support or e\-commerce operations experience

**What We Offer**

* ₹15,000/month to start, with a clear path to ₹20,000–₹25,000 after a 3\-month performance review based on your performance
* Work directly with the founder and learn how a D2C brand runs end to end
* Fully remote, work from anywhere in India
* Real growth opportunity as the company scales into a role with more responsibility and ownership

**How to Apply (Important)**  
This is the only way to apply. Fill out our short application form here:

https://jointura\-cs\-ops\-typeform.vercel.app/

We review every form submission personally. Applications that skip the form will not be considered.
